name: clipboard
title: Clipboard
description: A board with a spring clip holding a sheet of paper. The board is one drawn sheet (hardboard with the grain of its fiber, or colored plastic; a bevel lit from the upper left) that turns and casts its own shadow; the chrome clip is drawn over the paper it holds. The sheet is real DOM: put a form, a checklist or notes on it.

a11y: The board and the clip are aria-hidden decoration (the clip is an intrinsic `prop` drawn over the paper, with no pointer events); everything on the paper is ordinary content. Make the paper a `form`, `section` or `article` with a label when it means more than a block of text.
Ink on the paper is 14:1. The paper is drawn on cream even on a colored board, so contrast never depends on the board's color. The clip hides in calm density; the tilt is zero there.
Windows high contrast replaces the board with an outline; the paper keeps its own.
meta.usage:
import { Clipboard, ClipboardPaper } from "@/components/ui/clipboard"
